responses.text: {Player not in NCR gear} {fearful} You're here for the money. I told the Omertas I was good for it! I just need more time!
{Player in NCR gear} {paranoid} You're not part of my unit... no, you're here for the money! I told the Omertas I was good for it!
Oh, uh, hey.
I operate the radio and call it in if we see any Great Khans moving out in large groups from Red Rock Canyon.
Oh. Uh... well, yeah, I can do that. Um, thanks.

topics.prompt: I brought updated radio security codes from Camp Forlorn Hope.

responses.text: Watch out for Great Khans.
Here's all the caps I've saved up so far. See? That's a pretty good chunk of what I owe right there!

topics.prompt: <Lie> I'm here because of your debt to the Omertas. Pay me what you've got and you'll get more time.

responses.text: I talked to the cashier at Gomorrah into forwarding me some chips - I was convinced I was due for a hot streak.
It, uh, didn't go so well. The Omertas were nice and said they'd give me some time to pay them back.
They also said if they had to talk to me about my debt again, they wouldn't be nice the next time.

topics.prompt: What happened between you and the Omertas?

responses.text: I... don't want to talk about it.

topics.prompt: I thought NCR Rangers were supposed to be tough and fearless.

responses.text: Yes.

topics.prompt: Fine. Let's talk about something else.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] We were on patrol near the Dam when a Legion raiding party jumped us. Didn't even have to time to radio it in.
I was hit in the head with a machete and knocked out. Didn't kill me, though some nights I wish it had. When I woke up, my nerve was gone.
The rest of my squad was crucified, butchered, mutilated. I don't know how they missed me. Maybe they didn't. Maybe they knew they'd broken me.
I gambled and drank a lot after that. Got into trouble, but the Rangers gave me a second chance instead of kicking me out. So, here I am.

topics.prompt: If you don't tell me, someone else will. I'd rather hear your version.
topics.label: < Speech 30 >

responses.text: [FAILED] No, I'm not going to bring it up.

topics.prompt: You sure? I'd love to hear that story.
topics.label: < Speech 30 >

responses.text: Maybe. But, thanks for saying it, anyway.

topics.prompt: You were too tough to kill, and you'll get payback on the Legion some day.

responses.text: {relieved} Yeah.

topics.prompt: Interesting. Let's move on to something else.

responses.text: {mournful} I... I was different back then.

topics.prompt: Pathetic. The Rangers should never have let you become one in the first place.

responses.text: Watch out for Great Khans.
